topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 20 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 3 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin-upgradeable.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (accesscontrolupgradeable, contextupgradeable, erc165upgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin-upgradeable.
